events.name: Project Jonah Oil Whale – Omega Nursery
events.locationName: Omega Nursery / Shark Pens – east side
notes: The first whale is strongly associated with the Omega Nursery / shark pens after Project Jonah.
The marker uses the Platform Omega POI anchor because no reliable exact whale coordinate was recovered.
Community reports place the surfacing area just east of the shark pens / near the largest nursery pen.

events.name: Project Jonah Oil Whale – 50:1
events.locationName: Between Refuel Outpost Gamma and Helios Reserve Orion
notes: One report says the whale did not appear until the player was within roughly 15 meters.
Some completed saves report no additional whale at this point; preserve this as an Early Access spawn/reliability warning.

events.name: Project Jonah Oil Whale – 118:38
notes: Steam post edited on 24 July 2026 lists the three known areas as shark pens just east, 50:1, and 118:38.
Other players in the same thread report seeing fewer whales, so the coordinate is stored but the spawn is flagged as variable in Early Access.
Do not transpose this coordinate to 38:118; the current edited Steam post reads 118:38.

designRecommendation.defaultBehavior: Hide Jonah whale markers until Project Jonah is marked complete; optionally offer a 'Show locked world events' override.
designRecommendation.reason: The whale locations remain useful after the quest and behave like persistent/repeatable world resources rather than quest steps.
